what: Declarations that a killed or truncated battery leg may be cited ROW BY ROW, and never as a family measurement. Read by tools/leg_audit.py; a declaration binds to the leg's exact bytes (sha256), so it cannot be widened to a different log later.
rules: A declaration is only consulted when the leg has NO closing SHARD rc= row; a closed leg is audited exactly as before.
The declared sha256 must equal the hash of the bytes actually read, or the leg reads FAILED-LAUNCH.
ROW-GRANULAR is never ADOPT: family=0, and no aggregate in the declaration may be quoted as a family number.
Row-shape checks still apply. A declared leg with a defective row stays red on that row and loses it from rows_citable.

declarations.scope: rows only; no family aggregate; population was selected=428, the leg stopped after 110 rows
declarations.reason: Killed mid-run (header state=RUNNING, no closing row). Re-running 428 rows does not fit a window at the measured 192.2s/60 rows; the 110 lines it did print each carry their own rc/pass/fail/crit and are citable one row at a time.
